critical_code_review_comments: server.py lines 782-808 duplicate the sample-*/pdf response pattern (Response(content=..., media_type='application/pdf', headers=...)) across 4 endpoints; factor into a helper _pdf_response(body, filename, inline) to avoid drift in Content-Disposition handling.

GET /api/joint/sample-legal-lens/pdf does not support ?inline=1 like /joint/sample-agreement/pdf does. If /samples/legal-lens-report tries to embed the PDF via <iframe>, browsers may force download. Add the same inline switch for parity.

PUT /api/cases/{rid}/professional-report allows saving success_indicators for any authorized professional user without a size cap on the fields object; the sanitize_fields path should enforce a reasonable per-field length limit to avoid megabyte payloads persisted to Mongo.
